name: On computing quantum waves exactly from classical action

isPartOf.name: Proceedings of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences

description: Establishes the exact computation of quantum waves entirely from classical least action and its associated classical density, providing analytical proofs that the Bohm quantum potential is identically zero across fundamental systems and field equations.

educationalUse: Provides explicit analytical proofs that the proposed physical density eliminates the need for an active Bohm quantum potential in fundamental quantum and classical physics milestones.
